Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform

Class RotateSelection

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base.Command
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args.Subcommand
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.AbstractTransform
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.RotateSelection
All Implemented Interfaces:
Argument, KeyedStatefulCommand, SemiStatefulCommand, StatefulCommand<Void>, EventListener
public class RotateSelection extends AbstractTransform
A sub-command of TransformCmd who uses the handles made by AbstractTransform and the key-setters provided by AbstractTransform from KeyedStatefulCommand to rotate a selection of points or triangles around a given axis.

As like any other implementor of AbstractTransform, rotate provides the following functions based on the given input:

  • (No Handle Selected) + UP/DOWN KEY : +/-(Z Axis)
  • (No Handle Selected) + UP/DOWN KEY (Arbitrary Axis) : +/-(Y Axis)
  • X Handle + UP/DOWN KEY : +/-(X Axis)
  • Y Handle + UP/DOWN KEY : +/-(Y Axis)
  • Z Handle + UP/DOWN KEY : +/-(Z Axis)

Aliases: rot, r

Unlike other AbstractTransform implementors, rotate provides a second (third when used) optional TypedArg which expects a Vector3 for an arbitrary axis to rotate around.

The mouse owner for rotate (RotateMouseOwner) actually provides a line indicating the actual axis you're about to rotate around (Only when a handle is selected. not including an arbitrary axis)

Typical Usage: 


     transform rotate             - Rotate Faces
     trans rot p                  - Rotate Points
     trans rot f (0, 0.2, 1.42)   - Rotate Faces around the Vector3 axis (0, 0.2, 1.42)
     selection r v (1, 0.3, 0.5)  - Rotate Points around the Vector3 axis (1, 0.3, 0.5)

See AbstractTransform for more information onthe distinction between point mode and face mode.
